sources.section: Description; type-species entry; version contributed 21-Jul-2017, Bernard Lathuiliere and Ewa Roniewicz; hosted by Natural History Museum
sources.observed: Dendroid/phaceloid construction, cylindrical corallites, costae and unequal radial costo-septa. Supports the basic thick-branch / separate-cup concept. Six branches, cup dimensions, exact septal count and palette are artistic; no specimen-exact claim.
Group-level stony-coral context. Does not by itself prove every named genus-specific feature.

Meandroid submassive/plate growth with continuous valleys and wall relationships. Used only as basic maze-valley inspiration; simplified authored winding layout is not an exact species skeleton or a fossil occurrence assertion.

sources.section: Description / Morphology; USNM 66448 and ROM 61034 captions
